title: Custom 3D Multi-Layer Golf Map
body_html:
Our BEST SELLING 3D Wood Golf Map, now with more details, more depth and an amazing aesthetic. We add as much detail as possible to our multi-layered maps including a rough layer, water depth, forests, desert texture, marsh texture and more.

We can design ANY COURSE IN THE WORLD! From world-famous courses to your local tracks, we can build it. When placing an order, enter the name, city, and state of the golf course you would like custom-made.

A proof will be sent prior to production for your approval.

Crafted to perfection, our custom golf course maps are more than just decorations; they're timeless gifts that speak to the heart of any golf lover. Imagine the joy on their face as they unwrap a personalized representation of their most cherished golfing memories. Each map is thoughtfully designed to capture the most important details of the course, creating a conversation piece that adds a touch of elegance to any room.

NOTE: We can add additional text (date played, wedding date, the score you shot, icons (house markers), and other personal customizations for an additional fee. We can also do courses that are 27 holes, 36 holes, etc. 27 and 36-hole courses require a fee for the additional design and build work needed. Please contact us for additional customizations.

title: Personalized Leather Golf Course Desk Mat
body_html:
We can design a golf desk mat for ANY COURSE IN THE WORLD! From world-famous courses to your local tracks, we can make it. When placing an order, enter the name, city, and state of the golf course mat you would like custom-made.

From the original makers of the 3D golf course map. Our one-of-a-kind leather golf course desk mats are the perfect gift for the golfer in your life. Each leather golf course desk mat is thoughtfully designed to capture the most important details of the course, creating a conversation piece that adds a touch of elegance to any workspace.

Over 3500+ courses made and 1000+ 5-star reviews. Get a unique gift to make any golfer smile (some might even cry ☺️).

PRODUCT DETAILS:
✦ Dimensions: 23.50"W x 15.75" H | 59.69cm x 40.00cm
✦ Buttery soft to-the-touch leather with a textured laser-engraved design
✦ Spacious design to fit any size laptop and mouse, keyboard, notepad and pen, etc.
✦ Multiple Color Options
✦ Water-Repellent Surface
✦ Easy to Clean
✦ Suede-lined Bottom

HOW TO ORDER:
STEP 1: Select your desk mat color.

STEP 2: Enter the name, city, and state of the course you would like made.

STEP 3: Sit back and relax as we design, personalize, engrave, and ship your custom golf course desk mat!

NOTE: We can add additional text (date played, wedding date, the score you shot, icons (house markers), and other personal customizations for an additional fee. We can also do courses that are 27 holes, 36 holes, etc. 27 and 36-hole courses require a fee for the additional design and build work needed. Please contact us for any additional customizations.

OUR PROCESS: (typically 5-10 business days from order to shipment)

STEP 1: Your order is placed. Please make sure to include the specific course name as well as the city and state where the course is located. Some golf clubs have multiple courses, if this is the case, please indicate the specific course(s) you would like included. Once an order is received, and the information is confirmed, it enters our design queue.

STEP 2: Your course is meticulously hand traced (every bunker, tee box) and designed by our team members and ourselves. To this day, either Tyler or Jeremy (co-founders) edit and sign off on every design. We use the latest GIS and satellite imagery. They are 100% to scale and 99.9% accurate (we have missed a hidden tee box from time to time).

Because our maps are 100% to scale, this can cause some courses' holes to be smaller. Courses that cover a large amount of acreage require us to 'zoom out' when designing the course.

STEP 3: Your custom desk mat design is engraved on one of our state-of-the-art lasers. After engraving, we clean, add the finishing touches, and package your desk mat to get it ready for shipment.

All production work is proudly completed within our shop in Traverse City, Michigan.

title: The Golf Project Golf Hat
body_html:
Elevate your golf game with our unique personalized golf hat, designed to combine style, comfort, and individuality. Crafted from high-quality moisture-wicking fabric, this hat keeps you cool and dry while shielding you from the sun’s glare. Its adjustable strap ensures a perfect fit for every golfer, and the sleek design seamlessly integrates with your favorite golf attire. Choose from a range of colors and styles to reflect your personality, whether you prefer a classic look or something more contemporary.

This product ships fast (same day if ordered before 10 AM EST).

Key Features:
✦ Premium golf hat made from polyester and/or spandex.
✦ Available in 81 colors & combinations.
✦ Water resistant & repellant.
✦ Breathable & lightweight
✦ Makes the perfect gift for the golfer in your life.
✦ Easy to clean & wash.

Delivery Details:
✦ We ship fast! Same day shipping if ordered before 10am EST.
✦ 2-6 day delivery to USA.
✦ Prepped and packaged with care.

Hat Colors:
✦ Black w/rope
✦ White w/rope
✦ Sandstone w/rope
✦ Army Green w/rope
✦ Navy w/rope
✦ Black Camo
✦ White Camo
✦ White w/gray brim
✦ Army Green w/gray brim

Patch Colors:
✦ Rawhide w/gold leaf
✦ Golf Ball Textured White
✦ Black w/silver leaf
✦ Saddle Brown
✦ Green
✦ Blue
✦ Light Brown
✦ Dark Brown
✦ Gray

Technical and Maintenance Information:
✦ Hats are snapback and fit most head sizes,
✦ We use the industries leading lasers to create sharp, crisp, and vibrant designs that will last.
✦ Easy maintenance: can be hand washed with soap and water.

Helpful Information:
✦ Colors can vary depending on your personal screen and computer settings.
✦ Questions? Reach out to us with any and all questions and we'll get back to you ASAP.

HOW TO ORDER:
Please read this carefully. Our products are made to order and we will make your product based on the personalization instructions you provide. We are unable to make changes once we have processed your order.

1. Select the number of hats you'd like (discounts for bulk orders).
2. Select your hat color.
3. Select your patch color.

THAT'S IT! We'll take care of the rest. 

SHIPPING, REFUNDS AND EXCHANGES:
All orders are processed in the order they are received and typically are shipped within 1-2 business days. 

Most products ship via standard UPS/FedEx and USPS ground and take 2-5 days to be delivered. Expedited shipping options are available at checkout.

Because each item is unique and made to order we cannot accept exchanges or refunds. All sales are final. With that said, if there are any defects, damages or errors we will happily make you a new product. 

If you have any questions, please reach out to us via Etsy messages. We'll be glad to assist. 

Please review our FAQ section to learn more about our proof policy, shipping/exchanges, international orders, lost and damaged, products, etc.
